description:
You are helping a community center director set up an unattended informational kiosk display in the lobby.

A presentation about the Riverdale Community Center's programs is already open in LibreOffice Impress at /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/community_kiosk.odp. It has 6 slides with content about the center's programs. Currently, slides only advance when clicked and the slideshow does not loop.

Your task:
1. Set ALL slides to automatically advance after exactly 10 seconds each. Use the Slide Transition panel (Slide menu > Slide Transition) and configure 'Automatically after' to 10s (00:00:10). Apply this to all slides.
2. Enable continuous loop mode so the slideshow repeats endlessly. Go to Slide Show menu > Slide Show Settings and enable the loop/auto option.
3. Save the file (Ctrl+S). It should save to /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/community_kiosk.odp

Do NOT modify the slide content — only configure the slideshow timing and loop behavior.
